name: Training Loop for Refractive Index Field
definition: A training procedure for an MLP representing a refractive index field, using JAX, Optax, and TensorBoard logging, with specific loss functions and checkpointing.
summary: It trains an MLP for 3D refractive index and emission fields using differentiable ray tracing, distinguished by combining Eikonal ray tracing with luminance integration and boundary regularization.
